note: Customer-facing summary of the supplied private manual. Conflicting contact details and internal procedures are intentionally omitted.

sections.title: Catalog scope
sections.text: The store sells musical instruments. It does not sell standalone accessories such as strings, picks, cables, cases, pedals or amplifiers.

sections.title: Store address
sections.text: The physical store is at Rua 14 de Maio, 3200, Centro, Campo Grande, MS, CEP 79202-333. Contact phone and email require confirmation because the manual contains conflicting versions.

facts.street_address: Rua 14 de Maio, 3200, Centro, Campo Grande, MS, CEP 79202-333

sections.title: Opening hours
sections.text: The store and WhatsApp service operate Monday to Friday 09:00-18:00 and Saturday 09:00-13:00. They are closed Sundays and holidays. Special dates may change the hours with advance notice.

sections.title: Payment methods
sections.text: The store accepts PIX, debit card, credit card and boleto. Credit card payments may be split into up to 12 interest-free installments, subject to the installment rules. Boleto clearance may take up to three business days.

sections.title: Installment rules
sections.text: Up to three interest-free installments have no minimum installment amount, except purchases below R$ 50, whose treatment needs confirmation. Four to six installments require at least R$ 80 per installment. Seven to twelve require at least R$ 100 per installment. Combined payment methods are allowed for purchases above R$ 2,000.

sections.title: Online purchase regret
sections.text: An online purchase can be returned within seven calendar days after receipt without justification. The item must be in its original packaging, unused, with accessories and manuals. Refunds use the original payment method within ten business days, and the store pays return shipping.

sections.title: Defective products
sections.text: The manual describes a 30-day store exchange window for manufacturing defects and directs later cases to manufacturer support. Section 8.1 separately states a 90-day legal warranty from receipt. The relationship between these windows needs human confirmation before a definitive answer for days 31-90. Misuse, falls, excessive moisture and unauthorized modifications are excluded.

sections.title: Preference exchanges
sections.text: Exchanges for color, model or size preference are allowed within seven days if the requested product is available. The original product must be in perfect condition and packaging. Price differences are charged or refunded.

sections.title: Exchange exclusions
sections.text: Custom or specially adjusted instruments, explicitly marked final-sale clearance items, and wind-instrument mouthpieces are not eligible for exchange.

sections.title: Campo Grande metropolitan shipping
sections.text: Within the Campo Grande metropolitan area, shipping is free for orders above R$ 500 and costs R$ 35 for orders below R$ 500. The exact R$ 500 boundary is unspecified and requires confirmation. Delivery usually takes one to three business days.

sections.title: Shipping outside Campo Grande
sections.text: Outside the metropolitan area, shipping uses Correios PAC or SEDEX or Jadlog. Price depends on destination CEP, weight and dimensions; this prototype cannot quote it. Large instruments may need a special quote. Shipping includes loss and damage insurance.

sections.title: Tracking
sections.text: A tracking code is sent by email and WhatsApp once an order ships. The prototype can only report a code present in the supplied order snapshot; it has no live carrier tracking.

sections.title: Promotions
sections.text: Promotions are periodic and apply only to selected or eligible products. Current eligibility and price must come from the active promotions and products data, not from the calendar alone.

sections.title: Promotion and PIX rules
sections.text: Promotions cannot be combined. The five-percent PIX discount does not apply to a price already on promotion. Promotional prices must be shown with the original price and discount percentage and depend on stock availability; an out-of-stock item cannot reserve a promotional price.

sections.title: Service scope
sections.text: Service should be friendly and professional. Prices, stock and delivery times require a current data check. Standalone accessories are outside the store's catalog. No verified partner-store list is supplied.

sections.title: Special service situations
sections.text: If a product is out of stock or discontinued, explain this and suggest verified available alternatives. Expired promotions cannot be promised. Complaints need human follow-up; no complaint-recording tool exists in this prototype.

sections.title: Legal warranty
sections.text: The legal warranty against manufacturing defects lasts 90 calendar days from receipt.

sections.title: Manufacturer warranty
sections.text: Most manufacturers provide their own warranty, usually between six months and two years. The individual product certificate states the exact terms.

sections.title: Warranty exclusions
sections.text: Natural wear, misuse, falls, extreme climate, unauthorized modification or repair, and cosmetic damage that does not affect function are excluded from warranty coverage.

sections.title: Personal data and privacy
sections.text: Customer data is used for orders, status communication and legal duties. Promotional messaging requires explicit consent. Data is not shared with third parties for marketing. A customer may request data deletion through the store's human service; contact details need confirmation.

sections.title: Policy ambiguity
sections.text: When a policy is ambiguous or conflicting, the assistant should ask the human team to confirm before stating a definitive rule.
